mapper.select: SELECT id, sn, crt_dt AS crtDt, msg_cn AS msgCn, rcptn_rgn_nm AS rcptnRgnNm, emrg_step_nm AS emrgStepNm, dst_type AS dstType, visible_yn AS visibleYn FROM disaster_text_history WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update:
UPDATE disaster_text_history SET visible_yn = #{visibleYn}, mdfcn_ymd = CURDATE() WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO disaster_text_history ( crt_dt, msg_cn, rcptn_rgn_nm, emrg_step_nm, dst_type, reg_ymd, mdfcn_ymd, visible_yn ) VALUES ( #{crtDt}, #{msgCn}, #{rcptnRgnNm}, #{emrgStepNm}, #{dstType}, CURDATE(), CURDATE(), IFNULL(#{visibleYn}, 'Y') )
mapper.update: UPDATE disaster_text_history SET msg_cn = #{msgCn}, rcptn_rgn_nm = #{rcptnRgnNm}, emrg_step_nm = #{emrgStepNm}, dst_type = #{dstType}, visible_yn = #{visibleYn}, mdfcn_ymd = CURDATE() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT prsntn_sn AS prsntnSn, prsntn_tm AS prsntnTm, rlvt_zone AS rlvtZone, time_txt AS timeTxt, ttl AS ttl, warning_type AS warningType, content AS content, visible_yn AS visibleYn, maas_obnt_dt AS maasObntDt, is_manual AS isManual, lvl AS level FROM weather_warning_info ORDER BY prsntn_sn DESC LIMIT #{numOfRows} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weather_warning_info WHERE 1=1
AND visible_yn = #{visibleYn}
AND ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{newsType}, '%')
AND ( is_manual = 'Y' OR rlvt_zone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') )
AND (ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT prsntn_sn AS prsntnSn, prsntn_tm AS prsntnTm, rlvt_zone AS rlvtZone, time_txt AS timeTxt, ttl AS ttl, warning_type AS warningType, content AS content, maas_obnt_dt AS maasObntDt, visible_yn AS visibleYn, is_manual AS isManual, lvl AS level FROM weather_warning_info WHERE prsntn_sn = #{prsntnSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_warning_info ( ttl, warning_type, prsntn_tm, rlvt_zone, content, time_txt, maas_obnt_dt, visible_yn, is_manual, lvl ) VALUES ( #{ttl}, #{warningType}, #{prsntnTm}, #{rlvtZone}, #{content}, #{timeTxt}, #{maasObntDt}, IFNULL(#{visibleYn}, 'Y'), #{isManual}, #{level} )
mapper.update: UPDATE weather_warning_info SET ttl = #{ttl}, warning_type = #{warningType}, prsntn_tm = #{prsntnTm}, rlvt_zone = #{rlvtZone}, content = #{content}, lvl = #{level}, time_txt = #{timeTxt}, visible_yn = #{visibleYn} WHERE prsntn_sn = #{prsntnSn}
mapper.select:
SELECT '기상경보' AS category, ttl COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS title, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(prsntn_tm, 12), '%Y%m%d%H%i'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS eventDate, visible_yn COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS displayYn FROM weather_warning_info WHERE visible_yn = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT '재난문자' AS category, msg_cn AS title, DATE_FORMAT(crt_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS eventDate, visible_yn AS displayYn FROM disaster_text_history WHERE visible_yn = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT '지진' AS category, CONCAT(loc, ' 규모 ', mt) AS title, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(LEFT(tm_fc, 14), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS eventDate, expose_yn AS displayYn FROM earthquake_event WHERE expose_yn = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT '산불' AS category, CONCAT(fire_loc_village, ' ', fire_cause) AS title, DATE_FORMAT(fire_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS eventDate, fire_expose_yn AS displayYn FROM forest_fire_information WHERE fire_expose_yn = 'Y'
ORDER BY eventDate DESC LIMIT 6
